oracle.statement: PUT-create a name containing ue-umlaut/CJK/emoji: if create=2xx then GET describe on the identical percent-encoded name = 200 with result.config dict and GET on the one-character near-miss (swapped emoji) = 404 exactly; if create=4xx then GET on that name must be 4xx too (G9 face consistency), never 200; describe 200 on a create-rejected name = Type4_StateLogicViolation, near-miss 200 = Type1_IllegalSuccess, 5xx anywhere = Type3_RuntimeFailure
